title: Bihar BPSC 72 Pre New Exam Date 2026
vacancyDetails: 72nd CCE Prelims postponed from 26 July 2026; new date to be announced
qualification: Graduation as per BPSC 72nd CCE notification
ageLimit: As per BPSC 72nd CCE rules (post-wise minimum ages apply)
documentsRequired: Keep admit card download credentials ready when new date is announced
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.bpsc.bih.nic.in or bpsconline.bihar.gov.in
2. Read official postponement notice (18 July 2026)
3. Wait for revised exam date notification
4. Download new admit card when released
5. Do not appear on old date 26 July 2026
shortDescription: BPSC 72nd CCE Prelims postponed from 26 July 2026 due to unavoidable reasons. New exam date will be announced on bpsc.bih.nic.in.
content:
Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has postponed the Integrated 72nd Combined (Preliminary) Competitive Examination which was scheduled for 26 July 2026 (Sunday).

Official notice (around 18 July 2026) cites unavoidable reasons. A fresh date will be announced shortly on the Commission website.

  • Candidates should ignore the earlier exam date
  • Continue preparation and monitor bpsc.bih.nic.in
  • New admit card / schedule will follow the revised date
